chats.title: Summarize the onboarding process
chats.name: Aarav Poluru
chats.question: Summarize the onboarding process
chats.answer: New hires complete IT setup on day one, then follow the onboarding wiki for week-one checklists. Isha Poluru’s handbook covers benefits enrollment by Friday of week one.

chats.title: What benefits are available?
chats.name: Isha Poluru
chats.question: What benefits are available?
chats.answer: Full-time employees receive medical, dental, 401(k) match, and a learning stipend. Details live in Employee Handbook 2026, benefits chapter.

chats.title: How do we handle a safety incident?
chats.name: Aarav Poluru
chats.question: How do we handle a safety incident?
chats.answer: File the incident using the Safety policy template, notify the on-call owner, and keep equipment in place until Facilities clears the area.
